searchText: I think I found a spec violation in Lighthouse. When sending a pre-Electra attestation to `/eth/v2/beacon/pool/attestations` I get > "BAD_REQUEST: body deserialize error: Error(\\\"missing field `committee_index`\\\" But the v2 endpoint should support both pre- and post-Electra requests cc <@466006586477772831> there was some discussion here https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/531, I don't think Lighthouse supports pre-electra anymore most clients don't I would assume due to removing eth1 deposit code, so you can't build blocks pre-electra anymore yes, we do not support pre-electra attestations anymore

excerpts.author: radekkapka
excerpts.content:
I think I found a spec violation in Lighthouse. When sending a pre-Electra attestation to `/eth/v2/beacon/pool/attestations` I get

> "BAD_REQUEST: body deserialize error: Error(\\\"missing field `committee_index`\\\"

But the v2 endpoint should support both pre- and post-Electra requests

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: there was some discussion here https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/531, I don't think Lighthouse supports pre-electra anymore

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: most clients don't I would assume due to removing eth1 deposit code, so you can't build blocks pre-electra anymore

excerpts.author: 0xunclebill
excerpts.content: yes, we do not support pre-electra attestations anymore
